positions.as_written: Assess the subchondral region on the standing anteroposterior view, in the compartment that is narrowed.
Compare with the opposite compartment, which is the reference that needs no calibration.
Assess the patellofemoral compartment separately on the skyline view.
Sclerosis in a compartment the alignment does not load is discordant and should prompt a different explanation.
